# AEON Cloud

> Cloud-based 3GPP UE certification platform. We ship a digital box, not a physical tester — upload a UE build, run TTCN-3 conformance campaigns on real SDR-backed lanes from a browser.

AEON Cloud is a managed Conformance-Testing-as-a-Service (CTaaS) platform for telecom device makers. Instead of buying and racking a physical tester (Anritsu, Keysight, Rohde & Schwarz), teams sign up, connect their UE build, and execute 3GPP TTCN-3 campaigns remotely against LimeSDR and Ettus B210 backed radio lanes, with an AI Telecom Copilot for failure triage.

- [Docs](/docs): 41 engineering pages — install srsRAN UE, connect an open-source UE, TTCN-3 campaigns, TS 38.523 test selection, CLI/API/SDK reference, Jenkins & GitHub Actions CI, and failure debugging (registration, RRC setup, NAS security mode).
- [Blog](/blog): Field notes on 3GPP UE certification, TTCN-3, SDR testing, and cloud conformance.
